verdict.rationale: Yubico ships an official CLI, ykman (yubikey-manager), documented as "Configure your YubiKey via the command line." A runtime probe installed it from public registries (version 5.9.2) and describes scriptable control of applications, PINs, PIV/OATH/OTP slots and device info; Yubico's docs also cite ykman for reading device state such as firmware version. Missing for 10: first-party doc excerpts that detail the specific subcommands for enabling applications, setting PINs and managing slots, and hands-on evidence of those operations running against a real device (the probe only checked install and version output).
